name: Elegantdev Cart Recovery & Checkout Offers
author: Suman Kumar Das (ElegantDev)

sections.description:
Elegantdev Cart Recovery & Checkout Offers is a privacy-first, lightweight Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and cart recovery suite built specifically for WooCommerce store owners.

Reclaim Abandoned Carts Safely

Unlike traditional checkout tools that bloat your site with cookies and trigger annoying compliance banners, Elegantdev Offers utilizes a 100% cookieless server-side tracking engine. It calculates transient session signatures using IP + User-Agent hashed with a daily-rotating server token. No browser storage, no cookies, and zero compliance risks under GDPR, CCPA, and ePrivacy regulations.

High-Converting Exit-Intent & Delay Popups

Trigger beautiful promotional popups at the exact moment a customer is about to leave your site (exit-intent) or after a specified time delay. Elegantdev Offers copies the coupon code to the visitor’s clipboard and redirects them directly to checkout with the discount pre-applied.

In-Dashboard A/B Testing & Visual Analytics

Never guess what copywriting works. Elegantdev Offers automatically assigns visitors to Variant A (Control) or Variant B (Challenger) for your campaigns. Compare views, clicks, and checkout conversions in real-time on a dark-themed single-page admin dashboard with line charts.

Pro Features & Developer Ecosystem

Upgrade to Elegantdev Offers PRO to supercharge conversions:
* Checkout Urgency Countdown Timer: Fixed countdown alert on cart and checkout pages.
* Live Social Proof Toasts: Real-time recent sale alerts to build immediate buyer credibility.
* OpenAI GPT-4o Copywriter: Tailored AI copy generation directly inside the modal builder.
* Advanced Triggers: Launch popups based on page scroll depth percentage or cart item count.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the elegantdev-cart-checkout-offers folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress admin plugins search page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new Checkout Offers menu in your WordPress dashboard to create your first campaign.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin place cookies?

No. Elegantdev Offers is 100% cookieless. It tracks visits and conversions on the server side using transient cryptographic signatures that expire automatically every 24 hours.

Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes! Elegantdev Offers has native support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. Elegantdev Offers registers REST API endpoints to load campaigns and track analytics asynchronously, bypassing static caching from plugins like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed Cache.
